demo.urlTitle: What to type as the address
demo.urlHelp: With no hint words the address leads to an empty repository, or to a ready project when downloading one. Words in the address change the outcome: same, unrelated, other, plain, newer, empty. Failures: auth (needs a token), offline, missing, tls, slow, limit. An unknown ssh server asks you to confirm its key.
